free_parameters.name: nsize
free_parameters.why: Posit(4,1) width named by the finding; the witness carries no size key

free_parameters.name: es
free_parameters.why: exponent width used by the finding and by FlexPositConfig's default

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for the deterministic toy model built for the official entry

free_parameters.name: model_shape
free_parameters.why: tiny CPU model so the official entry quantize runs in milliseconds; the target decision depends only on the scalar passed to posit_encode

free_parameters.name: config_bits
free_parameters.why: base precision with no window upgrades, so quantize needs no sensitivity file

free_parameters.name: upgrade_nsize
free_parameters.why: FlexPositConfig requires base_nsize <= bits <= upgrade_nsize; unused at bits=4

execution.entry_reason: Step 4 reports call_chain status not_found: quantize() fake-quantizes weights to exact Posit values and never calls export.layer_codes/posit_encode, so the target cannot be reached from the entry. The driver calls the official entry quantize() with weights built from the input, then calls the target posit_encode() directly on the same value, as allowed for a not_found chain.
